🧠 FAQs & Troubleshooting Tips

💧 How do I shut off my main water valve?

Locate the valve near your water meter and turn it clockwise until it stops.

🚿 Why is my water pressure low?

It could be mineral build-up or a leak. Try cleaning aerators or contact support.

🔥 No hot water in my home — what should I do?

Check your water heater’s pilot light or circuit breaker first.
